name: Unidentified B1-series battle droid (Maridun)
description: A B1-series battle droid served under the command of General Lok Durd during the Clone Wars. While stationed on the planet Maridun, the battle droid was stationed in a Separatist command center and commanded his fellow units, only to be cut down by Jedi General Anakin Skywalker in a surprise attack.
